steelman.preferred_approach: A single COMMON-owned, production-independent oracle laboratory is the smallest coherent way to freeze nine known defect mutations, share receipt and lineage machinery, and preserve lane-local failure without prematurely changing production code.
steelman.strongest_objection: A common laboratory can become a correlated self-oracle or silently steal the scientific owners' later remediation if it imports production callables, shares unreported fixtures or random streams, or labels synthetic mechanics as matched validation.
steelman.resolution: Permit spec authoring only after explicit OBSSTAT/HTT contributor ownership, immutable mutation IDs, algorithm/source lineage fields, lane-local kill switches, and strict allowed/forbidden artifact use are written before execution.

proposed_acceptance_wording.text: PR-123 may establish only lane-specific analytic or synthetic numerical mechanics under roadmap_rescue_v1:C2 and canonical ClaimTier=conditional. Owner is COMMON; contributors are OBSSTAT for observer-side estimator, mock, rank, and transfer-range lanes and HTT for evidence/PPC and hierarchical-weighting lanes. Passing PR-123 is not cosmological inference, observed-data validation, matched-null/covariance validation, production remediation, or a disposition change. All 102 remediation findings remain OPEN.

Before any result is observed, the spec shall freeze exactly nine semantic mutation IDs: shell_monopole_leak, nonhermitian_rfft_plane, fixed_alpha_mock, low_order_curl_stencil, ignored_host_error, asymmetric_global_rank, fitted_score_pseudo_bayes_factor, plugin_pseudo_ppc, and stale_transfer_range. Each row shall bind lane ID, defect semantics, mutation source hash, independent reference hash, exact test selector, domain, seeds, tolerance, expected kill condition, owner, and later remediation PR. No mutation may be substituted or weakened after execution.

Every preregistered mutation must execute and be killed by its own lane oracle. Survival, skip, selector mismatch, tolerance drift, or unproven independence blocks that lane and is retained in the surviving-mutation report. G-PR123-MUTATIONS passes only with zero survivors; otherwise PR-123 cannot close as COMPLETED_SUCCESS even though a failed or blocked receipt remains a valid research artifact.

Each reference shall be smaller than the production path under a preregistered size/complexity measure, shall not import or call the mutated production implementation, and shall use a distinct algorithm and source lineage. The manifest shall record algorithm ID, source and equation hashes, shared equations, shared fixtures, author principals, random-stream namespace and seeds, production import/call negative scan, reference/production complexity, and non-author adjudicator. Shared equation, fixture, author, or random-stream lineage must be declared as correlation; file-path or source-hash difference alone is not independence, and internal multi-agent agreement is not external replication.

The K6 branch shall consume no CF4 row, selection, catalogue, reconstruction, or empirical artifact. It shall use analytic solid-body, potential, mixed-Helmholtz, and manufactured-boundary fields; at least four grids and two stencil orders; interpolation, boundary, kernel/amplitude-gradient decomposition; continuum extrapolation; and the analytic sqrt(2) residual lock under its stated iid-gradient assumptions. Any catalogue input, failed order/upper-bound property, or empirical consumer fails G-PR123-K6-CONTINUUM. The only allowed K6 statement is a catalog-independent numerical upper-bound/mechanics statement, never observed vorticity.

Every PR-123 spec, matrix, report, card, manifest, and receipt shall carry owner, contributors, implementation_scope, claim tier and level, artifact mode, allowed and forbidden use, transfer source, config hash, input hashes, sky/mask status, covariance/null status, caveats, generating command, seeds, environment, resources, git/worktree state, and consumer list. Allowed use is internal mutation-lab evidence, later-PR regression input, catalog-independent K6 mechanics, and downclaimed audit disclosure. Forbidden use includes observed estimates, p-values, significance, posterior odds, Bayes factors, PPC adequacy, matched-null/covariance claims, native-transfer or family/geometry claims, public scientific promotion, and RESCUED/CORRECTED_SUPERSEDED disposition.

PR4/NPIPE data commands_run shall equal 0. No command may download, size-probe, locate, inspect, hash, intake, reduce, cache, decode, or analyze PR4/NPIPE data; no PR4 input hash, derived number, table, figure, comparison, or PR3+PR4 joint result may enter a PR-123 artifact. Policy/document lint is allowed only when it does not touch a PR4 data path. Any PR4/NPIPE data command or derivative fails the entire PR-123 execution and requires quarantine plus a fresh run; PR4 absence is not a completed cross-check.
